components.name: Risk Pill
components.description: Neutral pill with a coloured dot; the number and word carry the meaning.
components.css: .ds-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; white-space: nowrap; padding: 2px 8px; border: 1px solid hsl(var(--border, 214 32% 91%)); border-radius: 9999px; background: hsl(var(--card, 0 0% 100%)); color: hsl(var(--foreground, 222 47% 11%)); font: 500 12px/1.33 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-pill b { font-weight: 600; } .ds-pill-dot { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 9999px; flex-shrink: 0; }

components.css: .ds-card { width: 220px; padding: 16px; border: 1px solid hsl(var(--border, 214 32% 91%)); border-radius: 8px; background: hsl(var(--card, 0 0% 100%)); color: hsl(var(--foreground, 222 47% 11%)); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.05); font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-kpi-label { font-size: 14px; color: hsl(var(--muted-foreground, 215 19% 35%)); } .ds-kpi-value { margin-top: 4px; font-size: 24px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.025em; } .ds-kpi-sub { margin-top: 2px; font-size: 12px; color: hsl(var(--muted-foreground, 215 19% 35%)); white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; }

components.name: Search Input
components.description: Text field for filtering and city search.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 260px; height: 40px; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid hsl(var(--border, 214 32% 91%)); border-radius: 6px; background: hsl(var(--card, 0 0% 100%)); color: hsl(var(--foreground, 222 47% 11%)); font: 400 14px Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: hsl(var(--muted-foreground, 215 19% 35%)); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px hsl(var(--ring, 221 83% 53%)); }

components.name: Tabs
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 36px; padding: 4px; border-radius: 6px; background: hsl(var(--muted, 210 40% 96%)); } .ds-tab { padding: 4px 12px; border: none; border-radius: 4px; background: transparent; color: hsl(var(--muted-foreground, 215 19% 35%)); font: 500 14px Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-tab:hover { color: hsl(var(--foreground, 222 47% 11%)); } .ds-tab-active { background: hsl(var(--background, 210 40% 98%)); color: hsl(var(--foreground, 222 47% 11%)); box-shadow: 0 1px 3px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1), 0 1px 2px -1px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1); } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px hsl(var(--ring, 221 83% 53%)); }

components.css: .ds-alert { display: flex; gap: 12px; align-items: flex-start; padding: 12px 16px; border: 1px solid #fde68a; border-radius: 8px; background: #fffbeb; color: hsl(var(--foreground, 222 47% 11%)); font: 400 14px/1.43 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-alert svg { flex-shrink: 0; margin-top: 2px; } .ds-alert p { margin: 0; } .ds-alert-title { font-weight: 600; } .ds-alert-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; margin-top: 6px; } .ds-alert-dot { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 9999px; background: #f59e0b; flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-alert a { color: hsl(var(--primary, 221 83% 53%)); font-weight: 500; text-decoration: none; } .ds-alert a:hover { text-decoration: underline; }

narrative.overview:
HeatSignal is the category standard executed carefully: a light, slate-and-white data dashboard that a parent on a phone in bright sun and a health official at a desk both trust at a glance. Everything that is not data stays quiet (white cards, hairline slate borders, one blue accent) so that the only strong colour on screen is the risk colour sitting on a number or a word.

Density is moderate and tabular. Pages open with a title and actions, then a row of KPI cards, then cards holding maps, tables and time-aligned charts. Figures use Inter's tabular numerals everywhere so columns of temperatures, AQI values and scores line up without effort. Dark mode exists as an opt-in toggle; light is the default and the reference.

The system explicitly rejects the dark, glowing "AI dashboard" the product had before: no glass, no glow, no gradients used as decoration, no emoji icons.
keyCharacteristics: Light by default; slate neutrals, white cards, 1px slate borders.
One blue accent for actions, links and selection.
Risk colours appear only on data and always beside a word or number.
Inter at a small, strict scale with tabular figures.
Lucide line icons at 16px; no emoji.
Flat surfaces with at most a whisper shadow.

rules.name: The Colour Carries Data Rule
rules.body: Risk colours appear only on data marks (pill dots, gauge arcs, map markers, chart band fills at 10% opacity, the peak dot, legend swatches) and always next to the word or number they encode. Colour reinforces; the word or number carries the meaning.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Blue is the only non-data hue in the interface. If something needs emphasis and is not data, use weight or Ink Slate, not a new colour.

rules.name: The Brand Bars Exception
rules.body: The wordmark's four signal bars (green, yellow, orange, red, low to high) are the one place risk hues appear without a value; they are the logo, not a pattern to reuse.

rules.name: The Severity Notice Rule
rules.body: The early-warning alert is the only tinted surface: a pale amber (High) or pale red (Critical) panel with a matching border and a warning icon, always carrying a sentence that states the city, the hours and the level.

rules.name: The Tabular Figures Rule
rules.body: font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums is set on body; every number in the product lines up in columns. Never switch to proportional figures for data.

rules.name: The Signage Exception
rules.body: Printed notices (the worker site card and the safety-advisor printout) keep bold uppercase section headings with wide tracking, because posted safety notices follow signage convention. On screen, headings stay in sentence case.

rules.name: The Shrinkable Cell Rule
rules.body: Every grid child gets min-width: 0 (.grid > *), so a wide table or long word shrinks to its track instead of pushing the page past a phone screen. Tables scroll horizontally inside their card.

rules.name: The No Glow Rule
rules.body: No coloured shadows, glows, blurs-as-material or decorative gradients. Depth is border plus tone.

dos: Do keep light as the default theme; dark is a toggle, not the reference.
Do pair every risk colour with its word or number (pill dot plus label, arc plus value, legend swatch plus band name).
Do use Signal Blue only for actions, links, focus and selection.
Do set numbers in tabular figures and keep the type scale to the six roles above.
Do use Lucide line icons at 16px.
Do let grid cells shrink (min-width: 0) and let tables scroll inside their card.
Do keep uppercase bold section headings on printed notices, and only there.
Do honour prefers-reduced-motion: all animation and transitions switch off.
donts: Don't use glass, glow, coloured shadows or decorative gradients.
Don't put risk colours on chrome, headings, buttons or backgrounds (the wordmark and the early-warning alert are the only exceptions).
Don't convey risk by colour alone.
Don't restyle or re-band the risk scales; they are fixed by WBGT, EPA AQI and WHO UV thresholds.
Don't add a second accent hue.
